description: This file defines a feature for listing tags in a C# ASP.NET Core project using MediatR. It contains a Query request, a QueryHandler that retrieves tags from the database context, and constructs a response envelope.

classes.name: List.Query
classes.description: Represents a request for retrieving tags, implementing MediatR's IRequest with a response type of TagsEnvelope.

classes.name: List.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the Query request by querying the database for tags, ordering them by TagId, and returning a TagsEnvelope containing the list of tag IDs.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Asynchronously handles the incoming Query by executing a database query to retrieve tags and returning an envelope with the tag IDs.
